      public void setCurrentPlayers()
      Sets the current players in the lobby. This method retrieves the current players from the GuiInterface and updates the playerList ListView.

    • addPlayer

      public void addPlayer(String nickname, Color color)
      Adds a new player to the lobby.

      nickname - The nickname of the player to be added.
      color - The color associated with the player. This method updates the playerList ListView with the new player's nickname.
